[[File:Pokémon Johto Collection.png|thumb|Pokémon Johto Collection cover]] [[File:Pokémon Johto Collection open.png|thumb|Pokémon Johto Collection opened]] The '''Pokémon Johto Collection''' is a Region 4 [[Collector's Pokédex Book]] DVD set released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on December 1, 2011 and in New Zealand on December 5, 2011. It contains 18 discs with 158 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13777. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. It contains all of the regular dubbed episodes of {{aniseries|PTS}} that take place in [[Johto]]. It contains episodes from [[S03|The Johto Journeys]], [[S04|Johto League Champions]], [[S05|Master Quest]] and [[S06|Advanced]]. In Region 4 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to standard [[season]]s, rather than by [[VIZ Media]] season. The final episode of the [[VIZ Media]] season Master Quest, ''[[EP274|Hoenn Alone!]]'', is not included, as it is set in [[Hoenn]] rather than Johto. ==Book== The discs come in a large book, designed to resemble the Johto [[Pokédex]]. The front cover and back cover together include portraits of all 100 [[Generation II]] Pokémon. Inside the front cover is a map of the [[Kanto]] and [[Johto]] regions in the animated series from [[Media:RegionsMoviesMap ReUpload.jpg|this map]]. The book has slots for 2 discs on each side of each page. Next to each disc in the book is an episode listing for that disc as well as a profile of a Pokémon that is featured in at least one of the episodes. This profile includes an original description, its [[height]] and [[weight]] (in metric units), its [[type]]s, its {{pkmn|category}}, its {{Abilities}} (but not its [[Hidden Ability]]), and its [[evolution]]ary line.
